purpose: Only needed to validate a future implementation boundary, not to justify the current source-level decision.
steps: Confirm canonical host runner override without starting a worker.
Start one minimal task-main request that launches a very short debugger Profile Task; do not execute in this reconnaissance.
Keep task-main non-terminal and debugger terminal.
Verify only task receipt, meta status, handoff and sanitized outbox event existence.
With Desktop online, observe UI event, parent session message, and whether any model generation resumes.
Repeat with Desktop closed, then reconnect and observe pending outbox/session-state visibility versus event replay.
Record duplicate behavior and profile/database target without collecting session content or secrets.
pass_conditions: completion receipt and handoff remain source of truth
delivery is targeted to the initiating session and profile
reconnect behavior is explicitly observed rather than inferred
automatic model resume is distinguished from UI-only notification
